# `candid docs`

Read the offline documentation bundle.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid docs [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `list` | List all doc topics. |
| `show` | Show a doc topic. |
| `search` | Full-text search the docs. |
| `command` | Show a command reference page. |
| `export` | Export the docs bundle to a file. |
| `version` | Show docs bundle and package versions. |
| `check` | Check docs coverage and links. |


### `candid docs list`

List all doc topics.

```
usage: python -m candid docs list [-h] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print topics as JSON |


### `candid docs show`

Show a doc topic.

```
usage: python -m candid docs show [-h] [--raw] topic
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `topic` | Topic slug (see `docs list`) (required) |
| `--raw` | Print raw markdown instead of plain text |


### `candid docs search`

Full-text search the docs.

```
usage: python -m candid docs search [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--json] query [query ...]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `query` | Search terms (required) |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | Max results (default: 10) (default: 10) |
| `--json` | Print results as JSON |


### `candid docs command`

Show a command reference page.

```
usage: python -m candid docs command [-h] [--raw] name
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | Command name (see `docs list`) (required) |
| `--raw` | Print raw markdown instead of plain text |


### `candid docs export`

Export the docs bundle to a file.

```
usage: python -m candid docs export [-h] [--format {txt,html}] --out OUT
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--format` `FORMAT` | Export format (default: txt) (default: txt) |
| `--out` `OUT` | Output file path (required) |


### `candid docs version`

Show docs bundle and package versions.

```
usage: python -m candid docs version [-h]
```

### `candid docs check`

Check docs coverage and links.

```
usage: python -m candid docs check [-h] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print problems as JSON |
